entries.title: How Sound Shatters Glass - Resonance Explained
entries.description:
Every object has a natural frequency at which it vibrates most easily.

When an external frequency matches this exact rate, the vibrations amplify through resonance. As the sound waves hit the glass, the molecular bonds stretch, creating micro-cracks. Under extreme stress, the glass shatters.

#Science #Physics #Acoustics #Resonance #StandingWaves #SoundScience #VisualScience

entries.title: How a Neuron Fires - The Action Potential
entries.description:
A neuron at rest holds a negative electrical charge inside its membrane.

When a signal arrives, sodium channels snap open, flooding the cell with positive ions. This electrical spike races down the axon, leaping between myelin gaps. At the synapse, it triggers neurotransmitter release to fire the next neuron.

#Science #Neuroscience #Neuron #ActionPotential #Biology #BrainScience #Synapse #VisualScience
